description: This file defines the SugarSQLValidate class, which provides methods for validating and sanitizing SQL query clauses, primarily focusing on preventing SQL injection and ensuring safe query structures within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarSQLValidate
classes.description: A class for validating SQL query clauses to prevent malicious or malformed SQL in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: validateQueryClauses
methods.description: Validates SQL WHERE and ORDER BY clauses to ensure they are safe and correctly structured.

methods.name: validateExpression
methods.description: Validates parsed SQL expressions for disallowed functions, subqueries, and unsafe column references.

methods.name: allowedSubquery
methods.description: Checks if a subquery is permitted based on specific allowed tables and structure.

methods.name: validateColumnName
methods.description: Ensures column names are safe, not containing dangerous characters or forbidden columns like 'user_hash'.
